attributes.description: Dashboard for RUM events collected by OTEL web agents

embeddableConfig.content: This dashboard provides an overview of your web applications performance and health, including number of visits, page load times and top errors. Use it to monitor your web applications instrumented by the OpenTelemetry JS SDK.
embeddableConfig.title: OpenTelemetry RUM

query.esql:
FROM traces-*.otel-*, logs-*.otel-*
| WHERE service.name IS NOT NULL AND MV_CONTAINS(?service_name, service.name)
| WHERE resource.attributes.user_agent.original IS NOT NULL
| USER_AGENT userAgent = resource.attributes.user_agent.original
| WHERE MV_CONTAINS(?browser, userAgent.name)
| WHERE MV_CONTAINS(?os, userAgent.os.name)
| WHERE resource.attributes.telemetry.sdk.language == "webjs" 
| WHERE
    MV_CONTAINS(
        ["@opentelemetry/browser-instrumentation/navigation-timing", "@opentelemetry/instrumentation-document-load"],
        scope.name
    )
| WHERE event_name == "browser.navigation_timing" OR transaction.name == "documentLoad"
| STATS `Total Visits` = COUNT(*)

        scope.name
    )
| WHERE event_name == "browser.navigation_timing" OR transaction.name == "documentLoad"
| STATS `Total Visits` = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-*.otel-*, logs-*.otel-*
| WHERE service.name IS NOT NULL AND MV_CONTAINS(?service_name, service.name)
| WHERE resource.attributes.user_agent.original IS NOT NULL

| WHERE MV_CONTAINS(?browser, userAgent.name)
| WHERE MV_CONTAINS(?os, userAgent.os.name)
| WHERE resource.attributes.telemetry.sdk.language == "webjs" 
| WHERE
    MV_CONTAINS(
        ["@opentelemetry/browser-instrumentation/navigation-timing", "@opentelemetry/instrumentation-document-load"],
        scope.name
    )
| WHERE event_name == "browser.navigation_timing" OR transaction.name == "documentLoad"
| EVAL
    `navigation.duration.us`
        = (TO_LONG(`attributes.browser.navigation_timing.load_event_end`) - TO_LONG(`attributes.browser.resource_timing.fetch_start`)) * 1000
| KEEP
    transaction.duration.us,
    navigation.duration.us
| EVAL load_duration = COALESCE(
        transaction.duration.us,
        navigation.duration.us
    )
| STATS `Load Median` = MEDIAN(load_duration)

FROM logs-*.otel-* METADATA _index
  | WHERE service.name IS NOT NULL
  | WHERE resource.attributes.`user_agent`.original IS NOT NULL
  | USER_AGENT userAgent = resource.attributes.`user_agent`.original
  | WHERE resource.attributes.telemetry.sdk.language == "webjs"
  | WHERE MV_CONTAINS(["@opentelemetry/browser-instrumentation/errors", "@opentelemetry/instrumentation-web-exception"], scope.name)
  | EVAL `attributes.exception.message` = TO_TEXT(`attributes.exception.message`)
  | WHERE attributes.exception.message IS NOT NULL
  | STATS `COUNT`=COUNT(*), example=SAMPLE(attributes.exception.message, 1), browser=SAMPLE(resource.attributes.browser.name, 1) BY ERROR=CATEGORIZE(attributes.exception.stacktrace)
  | SORT COUNT DESC
